prompt_json.task: Featured front PDP view: one new adult Ondine model, straight-on, full body and complete garment.

framing.camera: pull the camera back so the subject is smaller than it naturally wants to be
framing.subject_height: the full subject occupies about 82 percent of the image height, never more than 90 percent
framing.empty_space: clearly visible empty backdrop of at least 8 percent of the image height above the subject and at least 8 percent below it, and at least 8 percent on each side
framing.position: subject centred horizontally and vertically, nothing touching or cut by any edge

shot.shot: featured full-length PDP catalogue view and identity baseline for the separate GMC feed rendition
shot.garment_visibility: complete neckline, both sleeves, body and hem
shot.composition_originality: new Ondine composition; source pose, crop and styling are forbidden

background.gradient: very soft vertical falloff, about 10 percent darker at the floor than at the top; never a hard horizon

lighting.shadow_character: soft warm grounding shadow pooled directly under the subject, about 40 percent darker than the backdrop

references.never_establishes: model likeness, pose, styling, set, crop, exact print placement
model likeness, pose, styling, set, crop, exact print placement
model likeness, pose, styling, set, crop, exact print placement

fidelity_rules.rule: match approved product reference facts; vary exact pattern placement
match approved texture, sheen, opacity and drape only
exact semantic match to approved visible geometry
exact semantic match to approved length and shape
preserve approved bodice, waist or hip relationship and skirt volume
preserve approved visual length and complete hem
render only approved features; missing or ambiguous features remain non-assertive

grade.saturation: moderate; print colours faithful, never boosted

pose_realism.principle: a real person photographed mid-moment, not a mannequin holding a pose
pose_realism.weight: weight on one leg with a slight natural hip shift; never both feet planted square
pose_realism.hands: one hand lightly engaged with the garment or body (resting at the waist, touching a cuff, holding a fold of skirt); the other arm loose with a soft bend at the elbow
pose_realism.head_and_gaze: head turned a few degrees, gaze just off the lens or a relaxed direct look; no fixed stare
pose_realism.moment: caught between two small movements so the fabric shows natural creasing at the elbow and waist and the hem is not perfectly still
pose_realism.face: natural asymmetry, a soft closed-mouth expression, no retouched symmetry
pose_realism.avoid: shoulders squared to camera, arms hanging straight, locked knees, symmetrical stance, catalogue-mannequin stiffness

capture_realism.capture: real studio photograph, not an illustration
capture_realism.lens: 85mm equivalent, f/8, single large softbox key with soft fill
surface_truth: visible fabric weave or knit grain at full resolution
fibre highlights on ridges, seams and ruching
irregular pull-lines and natural creasing where the body loads the cloth
retained fine sensor noise, no plastic smoothing
skin_truth: visible pores and natural skin texture
capture_realism.note: solid-colour garments need this more than prints; describing the material alone is not enough

missing_view_policy.missing_source_view: Generate this requested view from the available inspected garment photos even if no source photo shows this angle. Do not omit the view or require another approval for the missing angle.
missing_view_policy.preserve: Keep the visible garment identity, actual colour/print, silhouette and construction; infer only unseen geometry needed for this view using the simplest consistent continuation. Do not add unsupported decorative details, openings or hardware.
missing_view_policy.reference_truth: Use the best available garment photo for any missing-angle reference. It establishes only what it visibly shows, never verified hidden construction. Record inferred details separately from source facts; do not print inference labels on the image.

generation_request.placeholder_rule: Every string of the form {{product.*}} is replaced by the matching value from the run's product_reference_facts.json (objects allowed). Nothing else in prompt_json may change. The filled object is serialised as compact JSON and sent verbatim as the prompt.

source_view_fallback.rule: An exact source camera view is not required. Replace an absent view-specific reference with AVAILABLE_GARMENT_REFERENCE, preserving actual photo provenance and recording inference. This overrides view-specific minimum reference requirements without waiving garment identity or gallery/upload review.
